notes: Render checked: sha256 a3bd8401... matches render-brief.json, 1080x1920, 30 fps, 300 frames, 10.0 s. I extracted every frame and checked every third frame at full size and at 360 px width.

Claims: every on-screen claim traces to the site source or to the organisers. '16 feathers / Set into a cork base... outruns a race car' is index.html:612 and matches site-home-facts.png. The five steps are the real register.html:69-75 list, pixel-matched to site-register-day.png. '11 CATEGORIES / AGES 8 TO 50+' matches index.html:555. 'Entries close Nov 18' matches register.html:55. 'shuttlestorm.adawar.org/register' is the source URL. 'NOV 21 2026 · UFV NORTH GYM · ABBOTSFORD BC' and the mark beside a SHUTTLE/STORM wordmark come from the site film end card (index.html:712-721). 'FEATHER SHUTTLES.' and 'GREAT PRIZES.' are organiser claims and are not expanded. shuttle-storm-mark.svg is byte-identical to favicon.svg and renders undistorted (frame 299). I found no invented content.

Material: the green halo on the shuttle art (frames 0-75) is in the site's own capture (site-home-everypoint.png), so the video did not add it. The volt is flat and the cards carry no glow, gradient or glass. The '16 feathers' underline is a flat volt rule.

Fixed since the last review: there are no frozen empty frames. Frame-diff shows that the only static runs are deliberate holds: 51-66 on 'GREAT PRIZES.' (0.53 s), step 1 at 91-115, step 2 at 125-141, step 3 at 151-167, step 4 at 177-193, step 5 at 203-220 (each about 0.57-0.83 s), and the end card at 258-299 (1.4 s). The register card now sits with 67 px gutters (x=67-1012), and the volt bar sits fully inside the card at x=92-99, reaching each step it marks.

Composition problem 1, the opening hook (frames 0-10): the shuttle art is a landscape band at y=462-1463. The top 462 px and bottom 457 px are empty charcoal, so 48% of the first frame is dead space, and frames 0-5 are near-static. At frame 18, y=1200-1920 is still empty. This is not the 'open tight' the brief asks for. Fix: start the art scaled to cover the full 1920 px height (crop on the shuttle head), then pull back.

Composition problem 2, orphan headline (frames 85-149): 'GREAT' leaves the top of the frame and 'PRIZES.' stays alone at y≈20-105 over the register card through all of step 1. In frames 120-149 the top edge slices 'PRIZES.' in half. On a phone it reads as a stray word. Fix: frame the register card so the whole 'GREAT PRIZES.' block clears the top before step 1 holds, or fade or mask the headline out once the bar enters the card.

Composition problem 3, end-card build (frames 232-252): the content ends at y≈1087-1207 and the lower 43% (y 1088-1920, up to 832 px) is empty for about 0.7 s, until the lockup arrives at frame 253. The final frame keeps 376 px of empty space below the date line (content spans y=0-1543), while the volt rule runs off the top edge. Fix: bring the lockup up with '11 CATEGORIES' (around frame 236), or lower the stack so the final composition is vertically balanced (bottom margin about equal to the space above '11 CATEGORIES').

Asset crop (frames 24-75): the shuttle art card shows dark vertical slivers of about 18 px on its left and right inner edges (x≈60-78 and x≈1000-1018 at frame 60), but none at the top. The capture's page-edge strip was included in the crop. Fix: crop the art to the canvas area only.

Causality: each step lights 2-4 frames before the bar starts to grow toward it, and about 4-7 frames before the bar reaches it. Step 2 lights at frame 116, but the bar still ends at step 1 (y=743) in frames 116-118 and reaches step 2 around frame 120-123. The same order happens at 142→144, 168→170 and 194→196. The consequence slightly leads the cause. Fix: trigger each step's highlight when the bar head crosses that step's title row.

Reference fidelity: the candidate inherits the one-path pipeline grammar. The bar leaves the promises, drives the steps and becomes the end-card rule. The middle 4.4 s (frames 90-222) is one text card with dim and bright states and short nudges, where the reference stops on a distinct surface at each stage. This is acceptable but thinner than the reference.

Mobile (360 px): the headlines, step titles, '11 CATEGORIES / AGES 8 TO 50+' and the lockup read well. Step body copy (about 12 px at phone width) cannot be read in the lit window of about 0.85 s, but the titles carry the meaning. The date line has caps of about 24 px at 1080 (about 8 px on phone) and the URL is about 9 px on phone, which is readable only with effort. Fix: raise the date line and URL to caps of at least 30 px at 1080.

Pass criteria: there are no hard failures, but composition (7) is below 8 and the average is 8.25, below 8.5, so the verdict is reject. Fixing the opening letterbox, the orphan 'PRIZES.' and the empty lower half during the end-card build should move composition to 8-9 and push the average past 8.5.
